512-950-4137.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

618-3967-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2469-4063-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Repeat.

728-2577-5268.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

141-5686-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5686-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

1233-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

57-1322-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1322-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-4068.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1453-2387-3490-4068.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

338-2034-3490-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
338-2034-3490-6458.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1894-3025-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

465-2511-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2173-2459-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

338-2541-6428.notablePrerequisites:
Magmakin Artillerist has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
338-2541-6428.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

500-2523-4365-6753.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

1339-2122-3334-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-3334-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1563-2351-5223-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-5223-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

539-2244-4803-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-4885.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2438-2459-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

176-4050-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-4050-5522.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat.

4067-4343-5042.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
4067-4343-5042.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

1947-3284-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Korvold's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

969-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

386-406-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil and Tandem Lookout is paired with Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
386-406-1525-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Borborygmos triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
